body:
### Summary

There is no equivalent to [UV_PYPY_INSTALL_MIRROR](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/reference/environment/#uv_pypy_install_mirror) and [UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_MIRROR](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/reference/environment/#uv_python_install_mirror) for GraalPy.
The same goes for settings: [pypy-install-mirror](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/reference/settings/#pypy-install-mirror) and [python-install-mirror](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/reference/settings/#python-install-mirror) exists, but there is no setting for GraaPy distributions.

I'm setting up uv use in all python projects for an administration. 
Security requires that components operate exclusively through proxy repositories, for traceability and failover (in case of outage or geopolitical threats).
uv mainly complies, but there are a few quirks: i'm creating issues for each of them.

My team would be happy to contribute with your approval: we are not Rust experts, but we can learn!

### Platform

Linux 6.8.0-138-generic x86_64 GNU/Linux, Windows 11 x64

### Version

0.12.23

### Python version

_No response_
